dialogues.speaker: Aged Temari
dialogues.text: (From the many scars and burrs this children's toy bears, you can tell that it was much-loved and used indeed)

dialogues.speaker: Aged Temari
dialogues.text: (Something has been written here that can be read even through the scars and damage: Okazaki Seishimaru)

dialogues.speaker: Aged Temari
dialogues.text: (Was this Temari here the whole time? Or did someone find it and put it here?)
